products.label: A
products.reason: It fits the firm’s existing out-of-band and mobile authentication offerings, but is a broader secure communication component rather than the same product type.

products.label: B
products.reason: It is essentially a mobile digital-signature feature, directly aligned with the firm’s existing mobile transaction signing and signature token products.

products.label: C
products.reason: It stays within the same security software domain, but broadens from specific authentication/signature tools to a full architecture offering.

products.label: D
products.reason: It concerns secure message delivery for mobile/security workflows, which builds on the firm’s existing mobile authentication and secure communication products.

products.label: E
products.reason: It is another hardware-based signature token, closely matching the firm’s existing USB, chip-card, and OTP hardware token products.

products.label: F
products.reason: It targets the same financial-security customer base, but shifts from authentication and signing tools to a compliance suite for payment networks.
